Also double check that https://github.com/Svetozar-Technologies/indian-law/pull/34 pull requests add features, or improves them, and does not delete them.

And we should continue to use Links Notation, Markdown and so on.

I expected to have more data and more precisely labeled, not less data.

Also as `https://law.satyavera.in/indian-law` is not available at the moment, we should restore `https://svetozar-technologies.github.io/indian-law/` to be working at the moment.
